github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: Use TypeScript for all code generation with strict typing
Follow Astro best practices: use .astro files for pages and layouts, React components for interactive elements
Use Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes for styling, leverage the new features like container queries and CSS functions
Prefer functional React components with hooks over class components
Use Astro's built-in optimizations: lazy loading, automatic bundle splitting, and static generation where possible
Follow Astro's island architecture - minimize client-side JavaScript by using client: directives only when necessary
Use TypeScript interfaces and types for props, API responses, and data structures
Implement proper error boundaries and loading states for React components
Use Astro's getStaticPaths for dynamic routes and getStaticProps pattern for data fetching
Follow semantic HTML practices and ensure accessibility with proper ARIA attributes
Use Vercel-specific optimizations like Image component and edge functions when beneficial
Prefer CSS Grid and Flexbox utilities from Tailwind over custom CSS

github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Generate tests using Vitest (Astro's default testing framework) with TypeScript
Create unit tests for React components using @testing-library/react and jest-dom matchers
Test Astro components by testing their rendered output and props handling
Use Storybook 9 for component testing and visual regression testing
Include tests for accessibility using @testing-library/jest-dom accessibility matchers
Test TypeScript interfaces and type safety with proper type assertions
Create integration tests for API routes and data fetching functions
Mock external dependencies and API calls appropriately
Test responsive behavior and Tailwind breakpoint changes
Include error state and edge case testing for all components
Use Playwright or similar for E2E tests when testing full page interactions
Test Storybook stories to ensure components render correctly in isolation

github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: Check for proper TypeScript typing - no 'any' types unless absolutely necessary
Verify Astro island architecture is followed - ensure minimal client-side JavaScript
Review Tailwind 4 usage for modern utilities and proper responsive design patterns
Ensure React components follow hooks rules and proper dependency arrays
Check for accessibility issues: semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation
Verify proper error handling and loading states in async operations
Review performance implications: bundle size, hydration strategy, image optimization
Check for proper SEO meta tags and OpenGraph data in Astro pages
Ensure consistent code formatting and naming conventions across TypeScript files
Verify Storybook stories are comprehensive and showcase all component states
Check for security issues: XSS prevention, input validation, secure API calls
Review Vercel deployment considerations: edge functions usage, build optimization

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use conventional commit format: type(scope): description
Include scope when relevant: feat(components), fix(api), style(tailwind), test(storybook)
Mention Astro-specific changes: island updates, SSG optimizations, hydration changes
Reference React component updates, hook changes, or context modifications
Include TypeScript-related changes: type updates, interface modifications
Mention Tailwind 4 specific updates: new utility usage, responsive changes
Reference Storybook story additions or component documentation updates
Include performance optimizations, bundle size improvements, or Vercel deployment changes
Keep commit messages concise but descriptive of the actual technical changes
Use imperative mood: 'add feature' not 'added feature'

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: Structure PR descriptions with clear sections: Overview, Changes, Testing, Deployment Notes
Highlight Astro-specific changes: new pages, component islands, SSG modifications
Detail React component updates: new hooks, state management, prop changes
Mention TypeScript improvements: new types, interface updates, better type safety
Document Tailwind 4 changes: new utilities used, responsive breakpoint updates
Include Storybook updates: new stories, component documentation, visual changes
Add screenshots for UI changes and component variations
Include performance impact: bundle size changes, lighthouse score improvements
Document any breaking changes and migration steps required
Add testing notes: what was tested, Storybook story coverage, accessibility checks
Include Vercel deployment considerations: environment variables, build settings
Reference related issues and provide context for reviewers
